plugin.name: OpenBiliClaw Recommendation Bridge
plugin.description: Syncs OpenBiliClaw's My Profile and browser-personalized recommendations, applies NEKO's pacing and safety gates, then privately lets the current character decide whether to speak.

panel.title: Personalized proactive recommendations
panel.subtitle: See what the plugin used, what it selected, and whether a candidate was handed to the current character to decide.
panel.alert.disabled: The plugin is disabled: it will not analyze new conversations or make NEKO speak. Configure the rules, then observe results in shadow mode first.
panel.alert.shadow: Shadow mode is observing: interests and candidates are updated, but NEKO will not actually speak.
panel.alert.live: Live mode is active. Gated candidates are handed privately to the current character, who may stay silent or speak using conversation, memory, and persona.
panel.config.safeTip: Keep shadow mode on first, review the candidates, then switch to live mode.
panel.fields.shadow: Shadow mode (record only, do not speak)
panel.fields.llm: Use a background LLM to extract interests and assess candidates
panel.fields.sourcesHelp: Uses capabilities from installed plugins only; no account cookies are read.
panel.data.title: Information the plugin actually uses
panel.data.recentConversation: New user messages from the last hour, used to extract non-sensitive interest signals.
panel.data.profile: OpenBiliClaw's My Profile summary explains browser-derived recommendations; NEKO's recent-chat interests remain an internal supplemental ranking signal.
panel.data.search: Titles, snippets, links, and sources returned by existing search plugins, used to build the candidate pool.
panel.data.activity: System privacy state, idle time, quiet hours, and the global proactive-chat switch, used to decide whether now is a good time.
panel.data.feedback: Only explicit like, dislike, or ignore feedback changes weights; character silence is never treated as user rejection.
panel.privacy.title: Information explicitly not used
panel.privacy.raw: Raw conversations are not written to long-term plugin state; only message fingerprints and extracted interests are stored.
panel.privacy.excluded: NEKO does not directly read browser history, Bilibili watch history, cookies, account favorites, or private pages. OpenBiliClaw alone uses that data within its own boundary to generate recommendations.
panel.privacy.boundary: Sensitive health, political, religious, or financial traits are not inferred; a private foreground state blocks delivery.
panel.lastRun.title: Latest check
panel.inspection.title: Inspectable recommendation state
panel.reason.away: User has been away too long
panel.reason.interval: Too soon since the last recommendation
panel.bridge.title: OpenBiliClaw recommendation connection
panel.bridge.downloadExtension: OpenBiliClaw ブラウザ拡張機能をインストール
panel.bridge.empty: No cross-platform events have reached the optional behavior ingress yet; recommendation sync is unaffected.
panel.bridge.configHelp: Reads final recommendations from the local full backend. The behavior ingress remains only for legacy compatibility.
panel.bridge.backendPortHelp: The full OpenBiliClaw backend normally uses 8420. The browser extension should connect to that backend too.
panel.bridge.ingressPortHelp: Defaults to 8421. It only accepts behavior events and does not generate complete recommendations.
panel.data.browserEvents: Final recommendations generated from cross-platform browsing behavior by the full OpenBiliClaw backend, including title, link, platform, recommendation reason, and topic label.
panel.privacy.browser: NEKO stores only sanitized recommendation candidates, stable IDs, and statistics. OpenBiliClaw continues to manage cookies, page snapshots, and raw platform events.
panel.empty.profile: OpenBiliClaw has not provided a profile yet
panel.profile.synced: This view comes from OpenBiliClaw's My Profile, not from NEKO's local chat clues.
panel.profile.emptyHelp: Start OpenBiliClaw on port 8420, let its browser extension build My Profile, then run a recommendation check.
